LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: ambitious
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Wants more land, more power and a name in the histories.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: cautious
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Avoids risks; fights only when there is no other way.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: greedy
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Counts silver before people. Trades hard and plunders gladly.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: generous
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Open-handed with friends and strangers alike.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: cruel
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Rules by fear and remembers every slight.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: just
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Keeps the law and their word, and expects others to do the same.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: warlike
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Happiest at the head of an army.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: peaceable
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Would rather pay than fight, and rather talk than pay.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: paranoid
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Sees plots everywhere and keeps a large guard.

LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.label: builder
LivingWorld.RulerTraitDef.description: Founds towns, digs wells and builds roads.
